typographie_suggestion.explanation: The main title "MÉCANIQUE CHIMIQUE" features the high contrast between thick and thin strokes, vertical stress, and small, unbracketed serifs characteristic of the Didone style (similar to Bodoni or Didot), which was prevalent in academic and formal French printing during the late 19th and early 20th centuries.
